employee.description: Mothers' allowance declared on the tax-advance declaration (adóelőleg-nyilatkozat): under-30 mothers, mothers of four or more, of three, or of two children (Szja tv. 29/D. § ff., including the birth-year conditions); it clears the tax base of the month

Under-25 allowance this employer may apply in a month, from the employee's declaration when shared between employers or waived (0); without it the full 715,765 Ft applies (Szja tv. 29/F. §, NAV booklet 73 point 13)
Personal allowance for severe disability (Szja tv. 29/E. §): 107,600 Ft a month
Part of the 33,335 Ft first-married couples' allowance this employee claims (Szja tv. 29/C. §; the spouses share it)
Number of dependants (eltartottak) setting the family allowance per beneficiary: 1, 2, 3 or more (Szja tv. 29/A. § (2))
Number of beneficiary dependants (kedvezményezett eltartottak), e.g. children with family benefit, for whom the family allowance is claimed
Beneficiaries who are permanently ill or severely disabled: +133,340 Ft each (Szja tv. 29/A. § (2a))
Beneficiaries cared for alternately by the separated parents, who count at half (Szja tv. 29/B. § (1e))
Share of the family allowance claimed by this employee when the parents claim it jointly (Szja tv. 29/B. §), e.g. 0.5
Working own-right pensioner: not insured (Tbj. 6. § (1)), so no tb-járulék and no szocho; income tax only
The 96,840 Ft minimum contribution base does not apply: full-time student, or receiving childcare/nursing benefits (Tbj. 27. § (3))
Minimum contribution base in Ft for a partial month or a month with sick pay, prorated by calendar days (Tbj. 27. § (2))

steps.message: Hungarian payroll is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template
Pay for the previous year paid after 10 January is income of the year of payment (Szja tv. 26. § (1)); it is not supported by this template
The number of beneficiaries cannot exceed the number of dependants, nor disabled or alternate-care beneficiaries the beneficiaries (Szja tv. 29/A.-29/B. §)
Pay is below the minimum contribution base in a partial month: the base is prorated by calendar days (Tbj. 27. § (2)), so set the employee's minimumContributionBase

steps.label: Social security contribution (tb-járulék), after family contribution relief
Social security contribution on the minimum base, paid by the employer

limitations: Employment paid monthly in HUF in 2026, for whole calendar months; pay is placed in the month it is accounted for, and previous-year pay paid after 10 January is refused (Szja tv. 26. § (1)).

Allowances follow the employee's tax-advance declaration: mothers' eligibility (including the 2026 birth-year conditions), the split of the under-25, first-married and family allowances between employers or spouses are entered, not checked. The under-25 allowance is applied automatically from the birth date unless limited.
The family contribution relief reduces this employer's tb-járulék on the actual pay, never the employer's contribution on the gap to the minimum base (NAV booklet 73, point 11).

Not modelled: szocho reliefs (labour-market entrants, career starters and others), the rehabilitation contribution, sick pay and other benefits paid by the employer, tax-exempt income subject to contributions, and pre-tax deductions (refused).
Amounts are rounded to the forint, half up, per line; no official rounding rule for the monthly advance and contributions was found.
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the acts and NAV's 2026 booklets; one case reproduces the published minimum-wage net pay and four follow NAV's worked figures.
